meta.title: DoA Threshold Currency (approval.doa.currency) = AED
gaps: Set the tenant setting approval.doa.currency to AED.
Use Modular Approval Setup to make approvals attachable to entities such as events, onboarding, purchase orders, payments, and letters of credit.
Observe and verify that DoA spend threshold definitions use AED and differ from the default INR behavior.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set the tenant setting approval.doa.currency to AED.; Use Modular Approval Setup to make approvals attachable to entities such as events, onboarding, purchase orders, payments, and letters of credit.; Observe and verify that DoA spend threshold definitions use AED and differ from the default INR behavior.

args.need: as Tenant Admin, set approval.doa.currency to AED, configure Modular Approval Setup for attachable approvals, and verify that all Delegation of Authority spend thresholds use AED

steps.note: The catalog cannot access tenant configuration, Modular Approval Setup, or the DoA matrix.
